review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 98-primary-file source inventory and representative runtime, code-generation, reflection, plugin, benchmark and test files. The README identifies the project as a production implementation of Google Protocol Buffers in Lean 4.

A declaration-class scan over every primary Lean file found no theorem, lemma or axiom declarations. The only checked proposition declarations are seven `example`s in Test/Core/Utils.lean, all native-decide smoke tests for Array.hasDups/hasDupsBy rather than protobuf or mathematical specifications.

The remaining tree implements codecs, descriptors, reflection, notation/elaboration, protoc code generation, JSON/runtime support, conformance tests and benchmarks; no independent mathematical theorem or formal-specification development is present in the frozen snapshot.
